run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with an input script file
create_atomic_data_from_lammps: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS atom positions, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers by matching closest atomic masses from a numpy array of masses
separate_run_commands: separate LAMMPS run commands from the rest of an input script into two lists
review_fix_external_callback: review the FixExternalCallback class that computes MLIP forces and virial for LAMMPS external fix
